# TRADESAFE

> > TRADESAFE is a comprehensive industrial safety supplier specializing in OSHA-compliant lockout tagout (LOTO) devices, eyewash stations, and workplace safety equipment.

TRADESAFE offers an extensive catalog of lockout tagout kits, padlocks, electrical safety devices, and emergency eyewash stations designed for industrial workplace protection. The company focuses on OSHA and ANSI compliance across all product categories.

## Key Topics

- Lockout Tagout (LOTO)
- OSHA Compliance
- Electrical Safety
- Circuit Breaker Lockout Devices
- Valve Lockout Devices
- LOTO Padlocks
- Group Lockout Boxes
- Eyewash Stations
- Industrial Safety
- Workplace Safety
- LOTO Kits
- Safety Equipment
- Emergency Response
- Keyed Different Locks
- Portable Safety Solutions

## Lockout Tagout Core Products

- [Lockout Tagout Kits](https://trdsf.com/collections/lockout-tagout-kits): Complete LOTO kits including electrical and valve lockout packages
- [Lockout Tagout Devices](https://trdsf.com/collections/lockout-tagout): Main LOTO devices collection featuring padlocks and lockout kits
- [LOTO Padlocks](https://trdsf.com/collections/lockout-tagout-padlocks): Keyed different and keyed alike LOTO padlocks for industrial safety
- [Lockout Tagout Supplies](https://trdsf.com/collections/lockout-tagout-supplies): Wide range of OSHA-compliant LOTO supplies and devices

## Electrical & Breaker Lockout

- [Electrical Lockout Devices](https://trdsf.com/collections/lockout-tagout-electrical): Electrical LOTO devices for safe power isolation during maintenance
- [Circuit Breaker Lockout Devices](https://trdsf.com/collections/lockout-tagout-breaker-locks): Circuit breaker lockout devices including clamp-on and MCB products
- [Plug & Socket Lockouts](https://trdsf.com/collections/lockout-tagout-plug-socket): Plug and socket lockout devices for electrical safety procedures

## Valve & Mechanical Lockout

- [Valve Lockout Devices](https://trdsf.com/collections/lockout-tagout-valve-lockout): Valve lockout devices for gate, ball, and butterfly valves
- [Push Button Lockout](https://trdsf.com/collections/lockout-tagout-push-button): Push button lockout covers for machine safety and OSHA compliance
- [Water Spigot Locks](https://trdsf.com/collections/lockout-water): Water spigot and faucet lockout devices with safety padlocks
- [Other LOTO Devices](https://trdsf.com/collections/lockout-tagout-other-devices): Variety of LOTO devices including cable locks and drum locks

## Group Lockout & Organization

- [Lockout Tagout Stations](https://trdsf.com/collections/lockout-tagout-stations): OSHA-compliant LOTO stations for visible device storage
- [Group Lockout Boxes](https://trdsf.com/collections/lockout-tagout-lock-boxes): Portable group lockout boxes for coordinated workplace safety
- [Safety Lockout Hasps](https://trdsf.com/collections/lockout-tagout-hasps): Industrial-grade LOTO hasps for group lockout procedures
- [Lockout Tagout Tags](https://trdsf.com/collections/tags): Tear-resistant OSHA-compliant LOTO tags for safety procedures

## Emergency Eyewash Stations

- [Emergency Eyewash Stations](https://trdsf.com/collections/eyewash-stations): Portable, wall-mounted, and pedestal eyewash stations for emergencies
- [Wall Mount Eyewash Stations](https://trdsf.com/collections/wall-mount-eyewash-stations): Wall-mounted eyewash stations for quick emergency access
- [Portable Eyewash Stations](https://trdsf.com/collections/portable-eyewash-stations): Self-contained portable eyewash units for facilities without water access
- [Pedestal Mount Eyewash Stations](https://trdsf.com/collections/pedestal-mount-eyewash-stations): Pedestal-mounted eyewash stations for OSHA and ANSI compliance
